[[File:Inv05-ArtoriasBase.jpg|thumb|right|The underwater Artorian safe haven]]

The '''Artorian safe haven''' was a domed shelter located on the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] floor several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] below the surface of the [[Great Sea of Artorias|Great Sea]] of [[Artorias]]. It was built on orders of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Caled Galfridian]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in order to provide shelter to the Artorian populace when it was rumored that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] would be expanding its presence into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. However, by the time the shelter had been finished, the civil war was over and the Empire was no longer a threat.

However, it came into use during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], when after the [[Battle of Artorias]] it became the base of the [[Artorias resistance]].
